senses.def: One of the many possible double helical conformations of DNA, induced to take this form in particular conditions such as relatively low humidity and the presence of certain ions.

forms_of: Côte-des-Neiges A district of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce borough

senses.def: single-stranded DNA that is complementary to messenger RNA or DNA that has been synthesized from messenger RNA by reverse transcriptase
